skeptic.head_reviewed: 7c29c75 (source identical to a881d18 outside acceptance/v5; later commits are docs/manifest only)
skeptic.summary: All four RETAIN verdicts are overturned to REPAIR. Their evidence (in-process counters, record-table hooks, sign/bound invariants) would also pass on the defects found. Columns have no writer ownership and wrap integers silently. An agent can take the handle of a population individual and receive money meant for it. The attention invariant cannot detect minting. Replay re-runs neural training and fails on another CPU ISA, and regeneration cannot run cross-process. The mode registry is satisfiable by a one-module 'civilization'. O.4 IMPLEMENT was harsh (EXTEND). SP-2.1 and P.1 have no implementation to repair (IMPLEMENT). P.4 EXTEND becomes REPAIR.

critical_findings: Recorded replay is not machine-independent. Replay/load re-runs neural training and fails under another CPU ISA, and regeneration cannot run in a new process. 'Replay without rerunning inference' holds only in-process.

Columns (the population state substrate) have no writer ownership and silently wrap integer values. Any module can rewrite population wallets, purchases or attention with no recorded population decision and no invariant firing.
Identity namespace collision: agents can register 'p<i>' handles and intercept payments addressed to population individuals.
Event/subscriber atomicity breaks when the emitter swallows errors: a forum post committed without its coupled content record (real 4.0 call sites).
SP-2.1's mode registry can be satisfied by a one-module 'civilization'.
